inspectionMethod: Inspected all required facings through four-view, logical-size and enlarged cream/gray/dark contact sheets, independently reconstructed those four sheets from the hash-verified submitted sprites and confirmed exact pixels. Also directly inspected comparison/repeated previews, real phone family/standalone/thumbnail/four-facing captures and desktop layered scenery. Independently reopened the actual .blend, audited geometry/camera/material/resource closure, replayed all four views and compared RGBA/published PNG bytes.
scoreInterpretation: Comparative observations against the original and fixed style target; no numeric pass threshold. Source original has a flat sharply pointed fan and tiny angular spots. This native candidate provides visibly rounded continuous volumes and controlled warm shading, with deliberately simpler detail than the illustrated target.

observations.evidence: All N/E/S/W silhouettes read immediately as the same five-armed starfish. Rounded arm edges and softened concave notches join a continuous raised center. Gentle center-to-edge shading supplies low rounded volume without separable wedge seams or collapsed arm notches. This is a material modeling improvement over the source open triangular fan.

Orange/coral midtones retain the original family and remain dominant. Cream/yellow nodules have rounded lit tops and subtle seated contact shading; they no longer resemble irregular angular chips. Their repeated spacing supports each arm and the central cushion, without crowding, unrelated decoration or a face. At logical size the silhouette and larger nodules remain clear; at the tiny phone family thumbnail, the star identity and pale accents still register.

Broad warm body highlights and restrained warm edge shading describe smooth curved form in every facing. Cream accents stay light without large white glare. No facing has a preferred horizontal light direction, black crease or muddy material patch. The source contains a centered broad key, four equal cardinal soft fills and uniform world light; no ground plane creates a directional shadow.

At logical1x and enlarged cream/gray/dark backgrounds, all four sprites have clean alpha contours and intact arm tips. I found no material black patch, coplanar artifact, detached nodule, clipping, bright fringe, external halo/speckles or dead spot. The real390x844 phone captures show readable standalone facings and the family thumbnail at actual catalog scale. Existing layered scenery retains the low-decoration scale beside the submarine and eel.

remainingDifferences: The target has deeper illustrated radial ridges, larger more varied cream nodules and more stylized faceted highlights. The native candidate uses smoother small cream cushions and a quieter broad body transition; these remain purposeful and readable at actual scale.

The native contour remains slender at arm tips and less inflated/glossy than the target, while rounded edges, concave notches and raised body volume visibly improve on the original. Target canvas occupancy is not treated as registration authority.

nativeSource.materialNodes: Native Principled shaders with geometry-height color ramp; no raster texture substitute. Actual scene has12meshes,one empty,one camera andfive lights.

bounds.interpretation: Inside1x1 footprint and z0..0.2 permitted envelope. Retains original0.38 radius scale. Original physical z0.07..0.17 was not mistaken for nominal0.2 thickness; rebuilt closed underside occupies lower space within the agreed envelope.

registration.method: Actual reopened source camera matrices/calibration match the object-specific input record to floating-point precision; unrelated35degree saved library camera is not used. Identical camera/light/material contract across all four root rotations.

nativeReplay.publication: One uniform0.5LANCZOS reduction of each entire native canvas; no pose fitting, alpha recentering, warp or recolor. PNG metadata differences in native replay are immaterial to exact RGBA agreement.

consumer.evidence: Hash-bound consumer/evidence.json and inspected actual catalog screenshots. Production image requests were redirected to candidate URLs; no consumer art/code substitution is needed.

technicalEvidence.limits: This is a standalone one-frame static decoration with no source rig, sockets, ports or modular join contract. Four native facings and real catalog context are proportionate; animation and modular assembly matrices do not apply. Approval is limited to this exact packet and grants no additional publishing scope.
